1.explanation: Carbon’s Tabs component has built-in responsive behavior: once the available width (measured against the viewport) is too small to render all the tabs inline, it switches to rendering a ListBox (dropdown) instead. By wrapping <Tabs> in a narrow container (here 320px), you force that threshold and reproduce the dropdown variant. Removing this behavior (per the bug request) would require disabling or removing the responsive dropdown logic in the Tabs implementation.
1.bug_scenario: When the browser (or container) width falls below a certain threshold, the Carbon React <Tabs> component automatically hides the horizontal tab list and replaces it with a ListBox-style dropdown. In practice you’ll see a blue-outlined dropdown button labeled with the current tab and an arrow; when you open it, you get a list of tab labels in a dropdown menu. This behavior is triggered by window‐width, not the actual width available to the Tabs component, and results in confusing markup for assistive technology.
